info.title: Maven Java project for JSON parsing

diffs.patch:
Index: pom.xml
===================================================================
--- pom.xml	
+++ pom.xml	
@@ -0,0 +1,61 @@
+<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
+<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
+         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
+         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
+  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
+
+  <groupId>com.example</groupId>
+  <artifactId>json-demo</artifactId>
+  <version>1.0.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
+  <packaging>jar</packaging>
+
+  <name>json-demo</name>
+  <description>Example Maven project that parses and generates JSON with Jackson</description>
+
+  <properties>
+    <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
+    <maven.compiler.release>17</maven.compiler.release>
+    <jackson.version>2.22.3</jackson.version>
+    <junit.version>6.1.3</junit.version>
+  </properties>
+
+  <dependencies>
+    <dependency>
+      <groupId>com.fasterxml.jackson.core</groupId>
+      <artifactId>jackson-databind</artifactId>
+      <version>${jackson.version}</version>
+    </dependency>
+
+    <dependency>
+      <groupId>org.junit.jupiter</groupId>
+      <artifactId>junit-jupiter</artifactId>
+      <version>${junit.version}</version>
+      <scope>test</scope>
+    </dependency>
+  </dependencies>
+
+  <build>
+    <plugins>
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+        <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
+        <version>3.16.0</version>
+      </plugin>
+
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
+        <artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
+        <version>3.6.0</version>
+      </plugin>
+
+      <plugin>
+        <groupId>org.codehaus.mojo</groupId>
+        <artifactId>exec-maven-plugin</artifactId>
+        <version>3.6.4</version>
+        <configuration>
+          <mainClass>com.example.json.JsonDemo</mainClass>
+        </configuration>
+      </plugin>
+    </plugins>
+  </build>
+</project>

parts.text:
Created a standard Maven project using Jackson:

```
pom.xml
.gitignore
src/main/java/com/example/json/Person.java
src/main/java/com/example/json/JsonDemo.java
src/test/java/com/example/json/JsonDemoTest.java
```

- `JsonDemo` shows generation (`toJson`/`toPrettyJson`), parsing to a POJO (`fromJson`), tree parsing (`parseTree`), and mutating a tree (`toJsonWithExtraField`).
- Build/run where Maven is installed: `mvn test`, `mvn exec:java`.

Note: Java and Maven aren't installed in this environment, so I couldn't compile or run the tests to verify.
